question: In which state of India is Sekrenyi Festival celebrated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nagaland.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sekrenyi is a 10-day festival **celebrated in the month of February as a part of mini Hornbill tribal festival in Nagaland. ***Hence option 1 is correct.***
 
• It signifies the purification and is the **biggest festival in the Angami tribe that is located in the Kohima district of Nagaland.**
 
• This festival includes cultural performance by Naga tribes, handicrafts exhibition, indigenous games etc.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
